assurance_contract.scope: Protected-person confidential service access: prove a narrow entitlement without unnecessarily revealing provider, relationship, location, case identifier or another durable cross-context correlator.
assurance_contract.non_scope: Claims about deployments, transports or implementation paths not represented by the immutable target and Interop Lab evidence producers in this run.
scenarios: A protected person presents minimum entitlement evidence to distinct relying contexts while relationship, task, verifier and status/policy surfaces are pressure-tested for unintended linkage.
risks: retained interaction evidence becoming a durable join surface
harms: exposure of a protected person's service relationship or activity across contexts
loss of confidentiality through compositional metadata linkage
assurance_propositions: The composed flow must not create unnecessary cross-context correlation through relationship identifiers, verifier transcripts, status/policy discovery or retained trust-task evidence.
cross_spec_assumptions: Component-level privacy properties do not imply composition-level unlinkability.
Evidence from target-native and composition-runtime producers must remain attributable and comparable across the tested contexts.
tests: composed status/task unlinkability A-B pressure test

harm_traceability.scenario: confidential service access across distinct relying contexts
harm_traceability.harm: cross-context exposure of service relationship or activity
harm_traceability.proposition: no unnecessary cross-context correlation in the composed flow
harm_traceability.control: context-bounded identifiers, minimized verifier transcripts, and unlinkable retained task/status evidence

assessment.title: Autonomous clean-room composition assurance assessment
assessment.target_title: Immutable VTI target under clean-room composition assessment
